title: CONSULTOR(A) TÉCNICO(A) COMERCIAL - CRUZ DAS ALMAS / BA
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

Ser um Consultor Técnico Comercial na TIMAC Agro é muito mais do que atuar com vendas. Aqui você trabalha lado a lado com o produtor , levando tecnologia, conhecimento e soluções que impactam diretamente a produtividade a campo. Você terá autonomia para desenvolver sua região, construir relações de confiança com os produtores e acompanhar de perto os resultados das tecnologias aplicadas. Além disso, fará parte de uma das maiores e mais qualificadas equipes técnicas do agro brasileiro , com acesso a inovação, suporte técnico e oportunidades reais de crescimento. Se você gosta de desafios, de estar no campo e de gerar resultados concretos, essa pode ser a oportunidade que vai acelerar sua carreira no agro.

O que você vai fazer

Como Consultor Técnico Comercial, você será protagonista no desenvolvimento da sua região de atuação, trabalhando diretamente com produtores rurais.

  • Atuar como Consultor Técnico: Entender a realidade do produtor, analisar solo, histórico produtivo, manejo e recomendar as melhores soluções.
  • Desenvolver e fortalecer sua carteira de clientes: Construir relações de confiança, proximidade e identificar novas oportunidades de negócio.
  • Acompanhar resultados no campo: Monitorar aplicações, desenvolvimento das lavouras ou animais e avaliar os resultados de produtividade.
  • Participar de ações técnicas e comerciais: Dias de campo, palestras e eventos junto à equipe regional.
  • Gerar relatórios técnicos e comparativos: Demonstrar os resultados obtidos com as tecnologias TIMAC.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação em Agronomia, Zootecnia, Medicina Veterinária, Técnico Agrícola ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência comercial com vendas no agronegócio CNH válida.
  • Conhecimento da região de atuação.

O que você encontra na TIMAC Agro

Na TIMAC Agro você encontra um ambiente que valoriza pessoas, resultados e desenvolvimento profissional.

Oferecemos

  • Salário fixo + comissões sem limite de ganho
  • Vale alimentação ou refeição
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico
  • Seguro de vida

Ferramentas para você trabalhar e crescer

Para que você possa focar no que realmente importa — gerar resultado no campo — a TIMAC fornece:

  • Veículo de trabalho
  • Cartão combustível
  • Celular corporativo
  • Tablet com internet

  • Assist with technical accounting research, and documentation of new policies and procedures
  • Support the AP process on a monthly basis, verify that all invoices are issued under minimum tax requirements and are booked correctly
  • Work with the Sales and CS teams on clients’ requests
  • Assist in the design of internal controls and policies
  • Support special projects, ad‑hoc reporting and other tasks as assigned

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in public accounting and/or working at a Financial Institution / Startup / Fintech
  • Experience with the month‑end close process to ensure the accurate and timely
  • Experience in developing, documenting, and rolling out cross‑functional processes
  • Ability to understand the business environment and apply the relevant accounting principles in simplicity, using practical methods to support the business owner’s needs
  • Creative thinking and out of the box solutions for complicated processes
  • Agile and able to pivot quickly with the changing environment
  • Collaborative and team‑oriented
  • Highly experienced in Microsoft Office, Google docs and Macros
  • Experience with national tax portal
  • Nice to have experience with Sage Intacct
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Fluent in English - Jeeves is a global company and English is the language we use internally to communicate between regions

Sobre a GreenYellow do Brasil

A GreenYellow é uma multinacional francesa especializada em transição energética, com foco em Eficiência Energética, Energia Solar, Armazenamento de Energia, Comercialização e Gestão Inteligente de Energia. Fundada em 2007 e presente no Brasil desde 2013, a companhia atua atualmente em mais de 15 países, apoiando empresas em sua jornada de descarbonização rentável e sustentável. Seu modelo de negócios é baseado no conceito de Energy as a Service (EaaS), no qual a GreenYellow investe integralmente, desenvolve, constrói, opera e mantém soluções energéticas de longo prazo, permitindo que seus clientes reduzam custos, emissões e riscos operacionais sem necessidade de investimento próprio (CAPEX zero). Globalmente, a GreenYellow possui um portfólio de mais de 3.500 projetos de eficiência energética, sendo mais de 1.400 no Brasil, atendendo empresas dos segmentos de varejo, indústria, telecomunicações, logística, mineração, serviços e infraestrutura. Em energia solar fotovoltaica, ultrapassa 930 MWp globalmente. No Brasil, a empresa já construiu mais de 250 MWp em usinas fotovoltaicas, além de um pipeline crescente de projetos instalados junto à carga (behind-the-meter), que integram geração solar, armazenamento em baterias (BESS), eficiência energética e gestão de energia, sobretudo para clientes comerciais e industriais (C&I). A GreenYellow posiciona-se como um player integrado de infraestrutura energética, combinando solução técnica, engenharia financeira, inteligência de dados e gestão contínua de ativos, com investimentos de longo prazo e foco na criação de valor sustentável para seus clientes.

Posição

Buscamos um(a) profissional para atuar na gestão financeira e contratual de ativos fotovoltaicos em operação, contribuindo diretamente para a performance e previsibilidade de receitas do portfólio. Esta posição é estratégica e está alinhada às melhores práticas do setor de energia renovável, onde a integração entre análise de dados, gestão de contratos e otimização de receita (revenue management) é um diferencial competitivo relevante, tanto no Brasil quanto em mercados mais maduros da Europa.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Conduzir o ciclo de planejamento financeiro (budget) dos contratos de usinas fotovoltaicas, com revisões periódicas de forecast (landing), seguindo benchmarks de FP&A do setor de energia.
  • Realizar a apuração mensal de receitas, integrando dados técnicos (geração, consumo, perdas, compensação) e financeiros, com análises críticas e reporte executivo.
  • Monitorar e analisar o balanço energético dos clientes (GD/FV), identificando oportunidades de otimização de receita e eficiência operacional.
  • Desenvolver e aprimorar modelos analíticos e ferramentas de previsão, aumentando a acuracidade e previsibilidade das receitas (best practice em utilities e IPPs).
  • Gerenciar contratos em operação, incluindo aplicação de reajustes, validação de cláusulas contratuais e regularizações.
  • Conduzir o processo de billing (faturamento técnico), assegurando consistência entre medições, contratos e faturamento.
  • Propor melhorias contínuas em processos, sistemas e controles, com foco em automação e governança.
  • Atuar na interface com clientes e concessionárias, garantindo resolução eficiente de temas operacionais e contratuais.

O que desejamos que você possua

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência no setor de energia (preferencialmente geração distribuída, comercialização ou utilities).
  • Excel avançado é essencial.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com visão integrada entre dados técnicos e financeiros.
  • Experiência com gestão de contratos ou revenue management será considerada um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de análise de dados (Power BI, VBA, Python, ou similares).
  • Diferenciais competitivos (benchmark de mercado): forte integração entre engenharia, dados e finanças (perfil híbrido), capacidade de atuar com grandes volumes de dados operacionais (data‑driven mindset), experiência com modelagem de receita e previsão (forecasting), vivência em ambientes com múltiplos stakeholders (clientes, distribuidoras, áreas internas), atuação orientada à performance de ativos (asset management).

Por que se juntar à GreenYellow?

  • Atuação em uma empresa global, referência em transição energética.
  • Exposição a projetos estratégicos e de grande escala.
  • Ambiente dinâmico, com foco em inovação e melhoria contínua.
  • Desenvolvimento em uma posição chave para o crescimento do negócio.
  • Valorização do impacto real: contribuir para uma transição energética sustentável.
  • Ambiente multicultural com empresa humana e líder acessível.

  • Comprometimento com CSRs fortes, incluindo meta de neutralidade de carbono até 2040.

title: Inscrições abertas para vendedores ambulantes do Carnaval 2026 em Campo Grande
description:
Aberto para Vendedores Ambulantes - Carnaval 2026

A Prefeitura de Campo Grande, por meio da Fundação Municipal de Cultura (Fundac), abriu inscrições para a seleção de vendedores ambulantes não circulantes para o Carnaval 2026, que será realizado de 13 a 17 de fevereiro na Esplanada Ferroviária.

Inscrições online disponíveis até quinta-feira, 22 de janeiro, às 17h. O cadastro é pessoal e intransferível.

Para participar, devem ser maiores de 18 anos, apresentando identidade com CPF, comprovante de residência, carteira sanitária e certificado de curso de higiene e manipulação de alimentos. Pessoas com impedimentos legais ou estrangeiros em situação irregular não podem se inscrever.

Seleção e Disposição de Pontos

O sorteio público será no dia 3 de fevereiro, às 9h, no auditório da Esplanada Ferroviária.

Serão disponibilizados 40 pontos fixos: 15 para alimentos e bebidas não alcoólicas (Tipo 1) e 25 para bebidas alcoólicas e não alcoólicas (Tipo 2). Cada ponto terá 3 m x 3 m, e os vendedores atuarão exclusivamente no espaço sorteado.

Horário de Funcionamento

Vendas permitidas das 15h até a meia-noite. Entrada de veículos para montagem somente entre 8h e 14h.

Produtos Permitidos e Restrições

Produtos autorizados: hambúrgueres, pastéis, pizzas, espetos, bebidas não alcoólicas e alcoólicas. É proibido o uso de recipientes de vidro e a venda de álcool para menores de 18 anos.

Reservas de Vagas

O edital reserva 10% das vagas para candidatos negros e 5% para indígenas, revertendo vagas remanescentes para ampla concorrência.

O edital completo está disponível no Diário Oficial do Município (Diogrande).

title: External Moderator
description:
Job category: Others: Education and Training

Contract: Temporary

EE position: Yes

Introduction

MANCOSA, a DHET registered, and CHE accredited private higher education distance education provider, offering undergraduate and postgraduate Education qualifications, has the following vacancy available: External Moderator

CORE PURPOSE

To safeguard the academic integrity and quality of MANCOSA's assessment processes through the independent moderation of assessment instruments and marked student scripts, ensuring that assessments are fair, valid, reliable, appropriately pitched and aligned to programme learning outcomes, applicable NQF level descriptors and institutional quality standards.

CORE FUNCTIONS

  • Moderate assessment bundles, including question papers, marking memoranda and rubrics, in accordance with institutional policies and prescribed timelines.
  • Evaluate assessments for validity, fairness, academic rigour, content alignment and appropriateness to the relevant NQF level.
  • Review and approve assessment instruments or recommend revisions to enhance quality and alignment with learning outcomes.
  • Moderate samples of marked student scripts to verify the consistency, fairness and accuracy of marking practices.
  • Confirm that approved memoranda and rubrics have been applied appropriately across the student cohort.
  • Recommend mark adjustments where warranted in accordance with institutional policies and governance requirements.
  • Prepare and submit comprehensive moderation reports, highlighting findings, recommendations and identified areas for improvement.
  • Participate in Marker Check Meetings and other quality assurance activities where required.
  • Maintain independence, confidentiality and compliance with institutional policies, assessment procedures and POPIA requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • A formal qualification at least one NQF level higher than the programme being moderated.
  • Professional registration with a recognised professional body (where applicable) will be advantageous.

EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum of two (2) years' experience in a Higher Education academic role.
  • Minimum of two (2) years' experience in examining and/or moderating assessments within Higher Education.
  • Demonstrated experience in assessment quality assurance and moderation processes.
  • Experience within online and distance higher education environments will be advantageous.

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

  • Excellent assessment design and evaluation skills
  • Strong understanding of SAQA, NQF and Higher Education quality assurance requirements.
  • Excellent analytical, evaluative and report-writing skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and sound academic judgement.
  • Ability to work independently and maintain objectivity.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Proficiency in online assessment and learning management systems.

ADDITIONAL RECOMMENDATIONS

  • Recognised expertise in the relevant discipline or field of study.
  • Evidence of scholarly activity, research output or professional contribution.
  • Ability to maintain complete independence and impartiality in moderation decisions.
  • No actual or perceived conflict of interest with MANCOSA or allocated modules.
  • Moderators may not concurrently undertake examining, marking, facilitation or supervisory duties for the same module.
  • Willingness to participate in annual training, orientation and quality assurance initiatives.

Atuar na conversão de oportunidades em matrículas, contribuindo para o atingimento das metas comerciais da área.

Registrar atendimentos, atualizar informações no CRM e manter a carteira de leads organizada, garantindo previsibilidade e qualidade no acompanhamento comercial.

Participar de treinamentos, reuniões comerciais e alinhamentos da área, contribuindo com sugestões de melhoria para os processos de vendas, atendimento e experiência do candidato.

O que esperamos de você

Buscamos uma pessoa com perfil comercial, boa comunicação e capacidade de construir conexão rapidamente. É importante ter escuta ativa, postura consultiva, organização para gerir carteira de leads e disciplina para acompanhar oportunidades até o fechamento.

Também valorizamos proatividade, senso de urgência, resiliência para trabalhar com metas e facilidade para atuar em equipe, sempre com foco em oferecer uma experiência positiva ao candidato.

Ensino superior completo ou em andamento.

Experiência prévia com vendas consultivas.

Vivência com metas, indicadores comerciais e acompanhamento de funil de vendas.

Experiência com atendimento e vendas por WhatsApp e telefone.

Conhecimento básico em CRM.

Boa escrita, boa argumentação e habilidade para conduzir negociações.

Conhecimento em técnicas de vendas, como SPIN Selling, funil de vendas e tratamento de objeções, será considerado diferencial.

Por que essa oportunidade é estratégica?

Nesta posição, você terá papel direto na transformação da intenção de estudar em uma decisão concreta de desenvolvimento profissional. Mais do que vender cursos, você irá apoiar pessoas na escolha de caminhos que podem impulsionar suas carreiras, conectando objetivos individuais às soluções educacionais da instituição.

title: Product Manager - Accounting (Contractor)
description:
We're hiring a Product Manager who deeply understands accounting to own the Accounting & Finance Automation pillar within our Finance Operating System. This role will define how global finance teams manage corporate spend data, maintain financial accuracy, integrate with their existing systems, and handle compliance—eliminating hundreds of hours of manual work each month.

You will own the product experience for accountants, controllers, and finance teams who use Jeeves to manage corporate spend across 20+ countries. This requires deep knowledge of accounting principles (GAAP/IFRS), how finance organizations operate, multi-jurisdiction compliance requirements, and the financial workflows that matter most to our customers.

You will combine accounting expertise with product management craft—using your understanding of how finance teams work to identify high-impact problems, translate complex requirements into elegant product solutions, and leverage AI to transform manual processes into automated workflows that accountants trust.

Because our customers operate across LatAm, the US, and Europe—with diverse organizational structures, cross-border operations, and varying regulatory requirements—we strongly prefer candidates based in Mexico, Colombia, or Brazil who understand these regional nuances.

Location: This role is based out of São Paulo, Brazil , and is a full-time remote position where it is also possible to come into our office at complexo JK Iguatemi on a flexible schedule.

What you will do:

Accounting Domain Expertise:

  • Own the accounting user experience end-to-end: Design products that accountants, controllers, and finance teams use daily to manage spend data, maintain financial accuracy, and ensure compliance.
  • Deeply understand accounting workflows: How finance teams process transactions, manage data flows, ensure accuracy, and meet regulatory requirements. Understand what "correct" means in an accounting context and why precision matters.
  • Navigate multi-jurisdiction complexity: Design for customers operating across different countries, each with unique regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and business practices. Understand how accounting needs vary across LatAm, US, and Europe.
  • Champion data accuracy and audit-ability: Every feature you build must maintain proper audit trails, ensure data integrity, and support compliance requirements. Understand the downstream consequences of errors in financial data.

AI-Powered Automation:

  • Identify high-impact automation opportunities: Find where finance teams lose hours to repetitive, manual work, and determine where AI can transform workflows. Start from the user's pain, not from the technology.
  • Balance AI capabilities with accounting precision: Understand when AI-powered automation is appropriate vs. when deterministic rules are required. Know that errors in financial data have real consequences for reporting, audits, and compliance.
  • Prototype and validate AI solutions: Personally test AI-powered approaches to validate whether they actually work before committing engineering resources. Build quick proof-of-concepts to assess feasibility.
  • Ship AI features that accountants trust: Build transparency into AI decisions, enable easy overrides, and maintain human-in-the-loop workflows where precision matters. Understand that trust is earned through accuracy and reliability.

System Integration & Data Architecture:

  • Own the integration strategy: Define how Jeeves connects with ERP systems, accounting software, and other platforms that finance teams rely on. Ensure data flows seamlessly across systems.
  • Design for flexibility and configuration: Build systems that adapt to different customer setups, organizational structures, and business requirements. Understand that no two finance teams operate exactly the same way.
  • Ensure data integrity end-to‑end: Every transaction must reconcile. Design features that prevent errors, handle edge cases gracefully, and provide clear visibility when issues arise.

Customer Discovery & Requirements Gathering:

  • Be the expert on customer needs: Conduct regular interviews with controllers, accountants, finance managers, and CFOs to understand pain points in their current workflows.
  • Partner with customer finance teams: Shadow their processes, understand their requirements, and learn the nuances of how they work. Translate what you observe into actionable insights.
  • Convert pain into product vision: Transform qualitative feedback and workflow observations into clear product opportunities. Understand not just what customers say they need, but what they actually need.

Data Analysis & Insight Generation:

  • Track adoption and impact metrics: Measure how customers use the product, where they struggle, and what drives value. Build dashboards that diagnose problems and surface opportunities.
  • Analyze workflow data: Identify patterns in customer behavior, common pain points, and opportunities for improvement. Use data to validate hypotheses before committing resources.
  • Build business cases: Quantify the ROI of product investments—hours saved for customers, error reduction, improved workflows, and business impact.

Strategy & Vision:

  • Define the product roadmap: Build a clear point of view on where the market is heading, how customer needs are evolving, and how Jeeves should win in accounting automation.
  • Understand the competitive landscape: Track how competitors are solving accounting and finance workflows; identify gaps, differentiation opportunities, and emerging trends.
  • Stay current on the domain: Understand how changes in accounting standards, regulatory requirements, technology platforms, and customer expectations impact product requirements.

Communication & Stakeholder Management:

  • Speak multiple languages: Translate between accounting domain expertise and technical implementation. Bridge the gap between what finance teams need and what engineering teams build.
  • Partner cross-functionally: Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, Design, and leadership. Enable teams across the organization to understand the value you're building and why it matters.
  • Create high-quality written artifacts: Write strategy memos, product specs, business cases, and post-mortems that drive alignment and enable faster decision-making.

What we are looking for:

Required:

  • Profile 1: Accountant/Controller with Product Experience
    • CPA, CA, or equivalent accounting certification, OR accounting degree + 2+ years in accounting/controller/finance operations roles
    • Deep understanding of how finance teams operate, process data, and ensure compliance
    • 2+ years in product management, product operations, or technical roles working on financial software
    • Proven ability to translate accounting requirements into product solutions
  • Profile 2: Product Manager with Integration/Financial Systems Experience
    • 3+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, or platforms with complex integrations
    • Proven track record building products that integrate with ERP systems, accounting software, or financial platforms (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, QuickBooks)
    • Strong understanding of how data flows between systems, data mapping, and system architecture
    • Demonstrated ability to learn domain expertise quickly and become the expert on customer workflows

Required Skills (both profiles):

  • Strong analytical skills: comfortable with SQL, data analysis, building models, and translating data into product decisions
  • Understanding of how systems integrate and data flows between platforms (you don't need to code, but you need to understand architecture)
  • Hands‑on comfort with AI tooling: ability to test AI‑powered features, evaluate model outputs, and prototype solutions
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles (GAAP and/or IFRS) and how finance organizations operate (either from direct experience OR from building products for finance teams)

Domain Expertise (varies by profile):

  • For Profile 1 (Accountant/Controller background): Deep firsthand knowledge of how finance teams work, what accuracy means in an accounting context, and how regulatory/compliance requirements impact workflows
  • For Profile 2 (PM with integrations experience): Demonstrated ability to deeply learn customer workflows, become the domain expert, and translate complex requirements into product solutions. You should be able to learn accounting concepts quickly and speak credibly with controllers and CFOs

Communication & Execution:

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills—can write executive‑quality strategy docs and present to CFOs
  • Strong customer discovery skills: can run effective interviews with controllers and finance teams
  • Bias for action: you ship, iterate, and improve based on real user feedback

Location & Work Style:

  • Based in Latin America, preferably Mexico, Colombia, or Brazil
  • Deep understanding of LatAm accounting practices, regulatory requirements, and business operations
  • Willingness to work across global time zones, including up to 10% travel

Strongly Preferred:

  • Experience with expense management, AP automation, or spend management products
  • Background in management consulting (Bain, BCG, McKinsey) with a focus on finance/accounting transformations
  • Experience working with global, multi-entity companies with complex accounting requirements
  • Knowledge of SOX compliance, internal controls, and audit requirements

You’ll Stand Out If You Have:

  • Built AI‑powered features for accounting or finance workflows
  • Led integration strategies with ERP systems, accounting software, or financial platforms
  • Worked in accounting or finance operations for a multi-national company
  • Deep experience with LatAm‑specific regulatory and compliance requirements

Why This Role Matters

Accounting and finance workflows in spend management are fundamentally broken. Finance teams spend dozens of hours per month on repetitive manual work that should be automated. This isn't just inefficiency—it delays financial reporting, introduces errors, and frustrates talented professionals who should be focused on strategic work, not data entry.

As our Accounting & Finance Automation PM, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Transform how finance teams work for 5,000+ global businesses
  • Build AI‑powered solutions that finance professionals actually trust and adopt
  • Solve complex multi‑market problems across LatAm, US, and Europe
  • Shape the future of financial automation in spend management

If you're passionate about accounting and finance, love building products that solve real workflow problems, and want to use technology to transform how finance teams work—we'd love to talk to you.

title: [Job - 29613] Senior Data Scientist, Brazil
description:
Na CI&T , ajudamos grandes empresas a transformar o potencial da AI em impacto real nos negócios com AI Deployment, execução AI-native e tech-integrated business solutions.

Com 30 anos de experiência em transformação tecnológica, aceleramos inovação com expertise em agentic SDLC, application modernization, Data & AI, martech e business strategy.

Importante : se você reside na Região Metropolitana de Campinas, sua presença nos escritórios da cidade será obrigatória, conforme a política de frequencia vigente.

A CI&T está buscando um Data Scientist para integrar um programa estratégico de dados para um cliente do setor financeiro com foco em crédito agrícola. O projeto visa transformar uma operação hoje altamente manual e fragmentada — em uma Plataforma de Inteligência de Dados escalável, com capacidade preditiva e integrada ao ecossistema tecnológico do cliente.

O profissional atuará em um ciclo iterativo de desenvolvimento: começa com dados estruturados disponíveis e evolui progressivamente para incorporar variáveis externas (clima, safra, cenário macroeconômico, dados não estruturados). Operará em um modelo de entrega IA-native, com Databricks, onde agentes de IA apoiam a geração de código e pipelines de modelagem, e o Data Scientist é responsável pela definição metodológica, seleção de features, validação estatística e ciclos de melhoria contínua.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolvimento de Modelos Preditivos: Desenvolver modelos de propensão a default utilizando técnicas de ML tradicional (classificação binária, modelos ensemble como Random Forest, Gradient Boosting e equivalentes), com foco em precisão, recall e estabilidade em produção.
  • Seleção e Engenharia de Features: Conduzir análise exploratória de dados (EDA), identificar e selecionar variáveis relevantes a partir de dados contratuais estruturados e, progressivamente, incorporar variáveis externas (clima, safra, cenário macroeconômico, dados de recuperação judicial e fontes de notícias).
  • Experimentação no Databricks: Desenvolver e versionar experimentos de modelagem utilizando Databricks e MLflow, garantindo rastreabilidade de runs, parâmetros, métricas e artefatos de modelos ao longo dos ciclos iterativos.
  • Validação e Avaliação de Modelos: Projetar e executar estratégias robustas de validação (cross-validation, backtesting temporal, análise de estabilidade de score) garantindo que os modelos performem de forma confiável em janelas de projeção crescentes (3, 6 e 12 meses).
  • Ciclos Iterativos de Melhoria: Participar ativamente dos ciclos iterativos de refinamento do modelo — a cada sprint, incorporar novas variáveis, reavaliar performance e documentar aprendizados na Base de Conhecimento do programa.
  • Colaboração com Engenharia de Dados: Trabalhar em estreita parceria com os Data Engineers para garantir que os pipelines de dados alimentem corretamente os modelos, e que as saídas dos modelos (scores, projeções, alertas) sejam disponibilizadas nas camadas corretas da plataforma.
  • Comunicação de Resultados: Traduzir resultados técnicos dos modelos para linguagem de negócio, apoiando o Data Strategist na comunicação com stakeholders do cliente (superintendências, crédito, liderança).
  • Documentação Técnica: Documentar metodologias, decisões de modelagem e resultados em formatos estruturados que alimentem a Base de Conhecimento e possam ser consumidos por agentes de IA em fases subsequentes.
  • Monitoramento em Produção: Acompanhar a performance dos modelos em produção, identificar desvios de distribuição (data drift, concept drift) e propor ações corretivas ou re-treinamentos.

Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida em ciência de dados com foco em modelagem preditiva para problemas de negócio em produção.
  • Experiência comprovada com modelos de classificação e ensemble (Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, XGBoost ou equivalentes) em contextos de crédito, risco ou detecção de anomalias.
  • Experiência com Databricks para desenvolvimento, experimentação e versionamento de modelos (Delta Lake, MLflow, Spark MLlib ou bibliotecas equivalentes em ambiente distribuído).
  • Sólido domínio de seleção de features, tratamento de dados desbalanceados e estratégias de validação temporal para modelos de risco.
  • Experiência em análise e modelagem de dados no ecossistema AWS (S3, Athena, SageMaker ou serviços equivalentes de ML gerenciado em nuvem).
  • Capacidade de comunicar resultados e limitações de modelos para audiências não técnicas, com clareza e orientação para decisão de negócio.
  • Experiência no setor de serviços financeiros (crédito, risco, inadimplência ou similares).

Diferenciais

  • Inglês em nível técnico de leitura e documentação.
  • Experiência com modelos de crédito agrícola ou segmentos com sazonalidade e variáveis externas de clima e safra.
  • Familiaridade com incorporação de dados não estruturados em pipelines de modelagem (NLP, embeddings, dados de mídia).
  • Experiência com monitoramento de modelos em produção (drift detection, retraining automatizado) usando MLflow ou ferramentas equivalentes.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de explicabilidade de modelos (SHAP, LIME ou equivalentes), relevante para ambientes regulados.
  • Familiaridade com modelos de entrega IA-native e uso de agentes de IA para aceleração de ciclos de desenvolvimento.
  • Certificações em ML/AI ou Databricks (Databricks Certified Machine Learning Associate/Professional, AWS Machine Learning Specialty ou equivalentes).

description:
Do you want to do work that matters, alongside supportive leaders who will help you grow faster than you ever thought possible? Are you a creative problem-solver who is energized by challenges? You’ve come to the right place.

YOUR IMPACT

You will lead technical teams, architect data platforms, and build scalable pipelines while mentoring colleagues and collaborating with clients at all levels. You’ll tackle impactful challenges, contribute to R&D, and grow as a leader by working with diverse experts on cutting‑edge AI projects across industries. You will lead multiple technical teams and own the technology stack for enterprise data and AI platforms. You’ll design and build robust, scalable, and reproducible data pipelines for machine learning while ensuring information security standards are upheld. Additionally, you’ll mentor junior colleagues, contribute to R&D projects, and drive innovation within the QuantumBlack Studio Data Engineering community. Your work will address real‑world challenges across industries. Partnering with QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey and QuantumBlack Labs teams, you’ll help create innovative machine learning systems that accelerate AI adoption and solve business problems at speed and scale, enabling clients to achieve meaningful and lasting impact. You will be based in São Paulo as part of our global Data Engineering community. You’ll work in cross‑functional Agile teams alongside Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, and industry experts to deliver advanced analytics solutions. Collaborating with clients from data owners to C‑level executives, you’ll help architect impactful solutions that solve complex business problems and drive value. You will be in an exceptional environment to grow as a technologist and leader. You’ll develop expertise at the intersection of technology and business by tackling diverse challenges. Surrounded by inspiring, multidisciplinary teams, you’ll gain a holistic understanding of AI while collaborating with some of the best design, technical, and business talent in the world.

YOUR GROWTH

Driving lasting impact and building long‑term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture – doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward. In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else. When you join us, you will have:

  • Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast‑paced learning experience, owning your journey.
  • A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
  • Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
  • World‑class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well‑being for you and your family.

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent experience
  • 8+ years relevant professional experience
  • Ability to scope projects, define workstreams, and translate roadmaps into sprint goals, milestones, and deliverables within agile and iterative team environments
  • Proven experience architecting and building enterprise data and AI platforms as well as scalable data pipelines for advanced analytics use cases operating in production
  • Passion for and track record of effectively leading and mentoring more junior colleagues
  • Expertise in implementing software engineering best practices to drive enterprise‑wide improvement, including DevOps, DataOps, and MLOps
  • Strong software engineering and data engineering expertise, including distributed computing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Dask), cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), analytics libraries (e.g., pandas, NumPy, matplotlib), and modern data platforms and orchestration tools such as Databricks, Airflow, SQL, PySpark, Kedro, and RAPIDS
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, scalable, and robust code in object‑oriented languages such as Python, Scala, or Java, and experience supporting the development of junior engineers through collaborative code reviews
  • Extensive commercial client‑facing or senior stakeholder management experience
  • Exceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environment.
  • Willingness to travel
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, in English and Portuguese, with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels

title: Mecânico de Refrigeração - 181
description:
Movidos por nosso propósito de "Construir um futuro sustentável, onde pessoas e tecnologia caminham juntas para enfrentar, com coragem e paixão, os desafios mais complexos da engenharia térmica", na Mecalor, o impossível não existe! Nossa Gente transforma ele em realidade. Estamos construindo caminhos que nos levarão a este futuro sustentável e, para tornar esta visão em realidade, buscamos um Mecânico de Refrigeração .

O profissional será responsável pela brasagem de tubulações de cobre com material de adição e pela montagem dos circuitos de refrigeração e hidráulico dos equipamentos, assegurando qualidade, funcionalidade e conformidade com os padrões técnicos estabelecidos. É um cargo de alta exigência técnica, diretamente ligado à qualidade final dos equipamentos produzidos.

Seu trabalho abrange a interpretação de fluxogramas de refrigeração e hidráulica, esquemas de tubulação e desenhos técnicos, a organização de materiais e componentes para montagem, a realização de testes de estanqueidade e pressão nos circuitos, e o apoio em outras etapas da montagem conforme a demanda da produção — sempre com rigoroso cumprimento dos procedimentos técnicos, normas de segurança e requisitos de qualidade.

Buscamos um profissional com perfil técnico consolidado, concentrado, detalhista e rigoroso na execução — capaz de trabalhar em equipe, interpretar projetos com precisão e entregar equipamentos dentro dos mais altos padrões de qualidade e segurança operacional.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Ensino Médio Completo
  • Formação em curso técnico em Refrigeração
  • Experiência mínima de 1 ano na função
  • Experiência comprovada com brasagem de cobre em sistemas de refrigeração industrial
  • Leitura e interpretação de fluxogramas de refrigeração e hidráulica, além de desenhos técnicos
  • Perfil técnico, organizado, detalhista e comprometido com segurança
  • Trabalho em equipe e comunicação assertiva com a liderança

Atividades

  • Realizar brasagem de tubos e conexões de cobre com material de adição, utilizando maçarico de forma segura e eficiente
  • Montar o circuito de refrigeração e o circuito hidráulico do equipamento, conforme fluxogramas, desenhos técnicos e instruções de montagem
  • Interpretar fluxogramas de refrigeração e hidráulica, bem como esquemas de tubulação
  • Organizar os materiais, ferramentas e componentes necessários para a montagem
  • Realizar testes de estanqueidade e pressão nos circuitos montados
  • Cumprir os procedimentos técnicos, normas de segurança e requisitos de qualidadeApoiar em outras etapas da montagem dos equipamentos conforme a demanda da produção

title: Fisioterapeuta
description:
A mais60 é referência nacional em cuidar das pessoas idosas, atuando na reabilitação, tratamento e prevenção de doenças, proporcionando mais cuidado para mais saúde.

Se você é comprometido, tem um olhar estratégico para o cuidado e busca excelência na recuperação e bem-estar dos pacientes, queremos você no nosso time! Junte-se a nós para transformar vidas e criar experiências incríveis para nossos clientes e colaboradores! Vem com a gente fazer a diferença na vida de quem mais importa!

Confira os desafios e responsabilidades da função:

  • Realizar avaliações físicas e diagnósticos funcionais, elaborando planos de cuidado e prescrição de exercícios de acordo com as necessidades de cada paciente;
  • Atuar na prevenção de complicações e na promoção da saúde, contribuindo para a manutenção da funcionalidade e qualidade de vida dos pacientes;
  • Desenvolver ações de reabilitação e tratamento fisioterapêutico, acompanhando a evolução funcional conforme os protocolos e fluxos assistenciais da empresa;
  • Promover a mobilidade, autonomia e independência dos pacientes, respeitando suas limitações e objetivos terapêuticos;
  • Identificar fatores de risco, incluindo risco de quedas, realizando os encaminhamentos necessários conforme a linha de cuidado;
  • Conduzir grupos terapêuticos e atividades coletivas voltadas aos pacientes;
  • Orientar pacientes e familiares quanto às condutas, exercícios e cuidados necessários para continuidade do tratamento;Realizar registros de atendimentos e evolução dos pacientes no sistema Life Code;
  • Gerenciar a própria agenda, buscando organização, otimização do tempo e produtividade;
  • Realizar contatos telefônicos e atendimentos online quando necessário;
  • Zelar pela organização da sala de fisioterapia, equipamentos e materiais, garantindo um ambiente adequado para os atendimentos;
  • Participar de ações externas, eventos e iniciativas voltadas à promoção da saúde e bem-estar dos pacientes;

Para esta posição é necessário que você apresente os requisitos e competências:

  • Formação em Fisioterapia;
  • Desejável especialização e interesse em saúde do idoso;
  • Conhecimento em atendimentos clínicos para idosos;
  • Especialização em Acupuntura;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar: Segunda, quarta e sexta: período da manhã, e terça e quinta: período da tarde.

Oferecemos para você:

  • Salário atrativo;
  • Cartão Caju para alimentação;
  • Assistência médica Unimed;
  • Assistência odontológica Odontoprev;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Convênio com farmácia;
  • Convênio com SESC;
  • Oportunidades de capacitação profissional.

Horário de trabalho:

Disponibilidade para atuar de segunda a sexta, período da manhã de 08h às 14h, ou tarde de 13h às 19h.

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

title: Consultant, DFIR, Reactive Services (Unit 42) – LATAM
description:
Job Summary

The Consultant, Reactive Services is an individual contributor role within Unit 42, responsible for supporting digital forensics and incident response (DFIR) engagements across a wide range of client environments throughout Latin America.

In this role, you will work alongside Senior Consultants, Principal Consultants, and Consulting Directors to investigate cybersecurity incidents, perform forensic analysis, and help organizations respond to and recover from security events. You will contribute technical expertise during active investigations while continuing to build advanced DFIR capabilities in fast‑paced client environments.

This position is ideal for a DFIR practitioner who enjoys hands‑on technical investigations, problem‑solving, and working directly with clients during high‑impact cybersecurity incidents.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support and execute digital forensics and incident response investigations across enterprise environments.
  • Conduct forensic analysis of endpoints, systems, logs, and cloud environments to identify attacker activity and scope of compromise.
  • Assist with host, network, and cloud investigations during active security incidents.
  • Perform forensic acquisition and preservation of evidence following industry best practices and chain‑of‑custody procedures.
  • Utilize industry‑standard DFIR tools and methodologies to investigate malicious activity and support containment efforts.
  • Collaborate with senior consultants and engagement teams to deliver high‑quality client outcomes during incident response engagements.
  • Document technical findings, timelines, and investigative results for both internal and client‑facing reporting.
  • Provide remediation recommendations and support clients throughout the incident response lifecycle.
  • Maintain awareness of emerging threats, attacker techniques, and evolving cybersecurity trends.
  • Support the development of internal DFIR processes, playbooks, and knowledge‑sharing initiatives within the Unit 42 team.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3–5 years of hands‑on experience in Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR), Security Operations, SOC, or related cybersecurity disciplines.
  • Experience supporting investigations involving ransomware, intrusion activity, phishing, malware, or unauthorized access incidents.
  • Foundational understanding of forensic methodologies, evidence handling, acquisition techniques, and chain‑of‑custody procedures.
  • Hands‑on experience with DFIR tools such as EnCase, FTK, SleuthKit, Volatility, or equivalent forensic frameworks.
  • Experience working across Microsoft Windows, Linux, and macOS environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with the ability to perform technical investigations in high‑pressure environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate technical findings to both technical and executive audiences.

Language Requirements (LATAM)

Candidates must be fluent in any combination of the following languages:

  • English + Spanish
  • English + Portuguese
  • Spanish + Portuguese
  • English + Spanish + Portuguese (preferred)

The ability to communicate effectively with clients across Latin America is required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting enterprise incident response investigations across cloud or hybrid environments.
  • Familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Exposure to malware analysis, threat hunting, or endpoint investigations.
  • Experience working within consulting, managed security services, MDR, or incident response organizations.
  • Industry certifications such as GCFA, GCFE, GCIH, CISSP, Security+, or similar.
  • Experience supporting multinational clients across Latin America.

Travel

  • Willingness to travel up to 20% throughout Latin America to support client engagements.

title: Platform Engineering Expert - SAP's Big Data Fabric Services (BDFS)
description:
Platform Engineering Expert - SAP's Big Data Fabric Services (BDFS)

We help the world run better

At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we’ll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what’s next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You’ll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What’s in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

PURPOSE AND OBJECTIVES

Join an innovative, collaborative development environment and help shape secure data access and connectivity capabilities as part of SAP’s Big Data Fabric Services (BDFS). We are looking for a Platform Engineering Expert to help shape the next generation of SAP Data Accelerator and related BDFS platform capabilities across architecture, engineering execution, and production readiness. We do not work as data scientists analyzing or extracting data directly. We build the platform capabilities that make this possible.

THE PRODUCT

SAP Data Accelerator focuses on secure partner connectivity and access to SAP business data across SAP ERP and LoB applications in on‑premise, private cloud, and public cloud landscapes. This work sits within the broader BDFS portfolio, which enables SAP Lines of Business and customers to enter the world of big data more easily. BDFS delivers platform capabilities such as Apache Spark as a service, multi‑language data processing on Kubernetes‑based infrastructure, and access to hyperscaler‑agnostic data sources using the Delta Sharing protocol on top of the HANA Data Lake File Service (HDLFS). As the product evolves through future phases, the scope expands from secure connectivity into broader API‑driven and platform‑managed data access capabilities.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

As a Platform Engineering Expert, you will contribute across design, coding, testing, operability, and quality assurance in a development team, while also helping shape architecture and technical direction. You will assess and solve issues in new or existing code and work with high attention to detail, reliability, and efficiency. You will collaborate closely with your team members and stakeholders to ensure success.

In your day‑to‑day, your tasks will be:

  • Work on design, coding, and quality assurance tasks related to strategic product capabilities.
  • Drive platform decisions that balance security, scalability, operability, and product evolution across current and future phases.
  • Development activities in Java, Python, and Go, with Rust as a plus.
  • Work in an agile team that uses the Scrum framework to self‑organize and work towards development goals.
  • Mentor and guide the team to foster professional development and engineering excellence.
  • Support the team on technical discussions, architecture topics, and platform direction.
  • Help build PoCs, evaluate technical options, and drive important engineering decisions.

WHAT YOU BRING

Required skills

Core engineering and technical leadership

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Systems Analysis, Information Technology, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering.
  • Advanced or fluent English.
  • Excellent programming skills and knowledge of algorithms, data structures, space, and run‑time complexity (Big‑O notation).
  • Strong hands‑on expertise in Java, Python, and/or Go in cloud‑native and Kubernetes‑based environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex software issues leveraging technical and product skills.
  • Good communication skills.
  • Willingness to continuously learn both new technologies and business processes.

Platform, security, and operability

  • Strong expertise in networking concepts relevant to distributed systems, secure partner connectivity, and cloud environments.
  • Strong command of secure connectivity and platform engineering patterns, including OAuth 2.0, mTLS, multi‑tenant service design, and proxy or tunnel‑based architectures.
  • Strong background in production hardening, SRE practices, observability, and scalable multi‑tenant service operation.
  • Experience with observability practices including metrics, tracing, health checks, alerting, and OpenTelemetry.
  • Experience with scalability, autoscaling, capacity management, and performance tuning for distributed services.
  • Experience with secure software engineering, threat modeling, and automated testing across unit, integration, end‑to‑end, and scale scenarios.
  • Knowledge of AI‑assisted and agentic engineering tools, and the ability to use them effectively across the software development lifecycle.

SAP and platform architecture

  • Strong expertise in SAP backend integration, including SAP ERP (ECC or S/4HANA), the NetWeaver stack, and related extensibility patterns.
  • Experience shaping technical direction for secure partner connectivity and SAP data access scenarios.
  • Experience designing API‑driven platform capabilities such as self‑service enrollment, endpoint discovery, connection and session management, capacity management, or related control‑plane workflows.
  • Experience shaping control‑plane and data‑plane architectures for secure, scalable enterprise data access.
  • Willingness to take ownership, drive new developments, and work creatively on challenging and groundbreaking tasks in accordance with the highest technical standards, plus a high level of commitment, team spirit, flexibility, and initiative.

Nice to have

  • Rust development experience.
  • Hands‑on ABAP development experience.
  • Experience building SAP add‑ons or backend extensions.
  • Current hands‑on experience using AI‑assisted or agentic tools across the software development lifecycle.

LEARNING OPPORTUNITIES

  • By joining our team, you will help shape platform capabilities that evolve from current connectivity scenarios toward broader API‑driven and storage‑backed data access scenarios.
  • You will work on high‑impact engineering topics spanning platform architecture, security, scale, observability, and operational excellence.
  • You will collaborate with strong engineers across BDFS and adjacent SAP platform areas.
  • You will influence how secure enterprise data access capabilities are built for hybrid SAP landscapes over the next project phases.

You will work with your team on SAP Data Accelerator within SAP HANA Cloud & Datalakehouse / Big Data Fabric Services. These products help our customers access data from anywhere.

The Big Data Fabric Services team is responsible for:

  • Extend and complete the SAP Data Platform with big data technologies to support different SAP Lines of Business.
  • Leverage Apache Spark and object store technology to provide scalable and cost‑effective computing and storage services for big data ingestion, processing, and sharing.
  • Integrate into SAP BTP and HANA Cloud & Data Lakehouse to offer a unified development and deployment experience for different SAP Lines of Business.
  • Assure multi‑tenancy and secure data processing.
  • Build capabilities for secure partner connectivity and governed access to SAP business data.

In the BDFS team, we have an agile and collaborative culture where knowledge sharing is fostered.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, etc.), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements.

Successful candidates might be required to undergo a background verification with an external vendor.

Conduct regular one on one coaching sessions, usually on a weekly or biweekly basis. Run team meetings to ensure that your team is kept up to date with the latest information, share best practices and enhance overall team spirit.
  • Expertise Sharing Be a subject matter expert in your area with the ability to train and coach your team on operational topics. Maintain a good understanding of our regulatory obligations, internal policies, and applying a risk-based approach to deterring and preventing money laundering and financial crime. Able to perform deep dives, understand root causes of problematic cases and propose solutions to senior leadership.
  • Planning and execution Ensure key performance indicators are being met and provide insights to other stakeholders. Take full accountability in delivering your own initiatives and making sure your team is making progress on their goals.

title: DevOps & Security Engineer
description:
We’re building Reflow, a workforce and workflow intelligence platform that helps teams understand and improve how work gets done. As adoption scales, our infrastructure needs to be more secure, observable, and cost‑efficient. We’re looking for a DevOps & Security Engineer to help us evolve our cloud setup, strengthen security posture, and ensure Reflow runs fast, safely, and reliably at scale.

What you’ll do

  • Own infrastructure deployment, monitoring, and scaling across AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes), and automated deployment flows.
  • Design isolated multi-tenant environments for enterprise customers.
  • Implement and manage infrastructure monitoring, alerting, and performance dashboards.
  • Lead initiatives in data protection, encryption, and threat detection.
  • Manage infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible) to ensure reproducibility and version control.
  • Partner with engineering to plan and execute a migration toward a more efficient, secure cloud architecture.
  • Support ongoing security reviews, compliance efforts, and audits.

Who you are

  • Experienced in cloud infrastructure management (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Strong background in CI/CD, container orchestration, and automated scaling.
  • Deep understanding of infrastructure security, including encryption, access control, and monitoring.
  • Comfortable balancing performance, cost, and reliability when designing systems.
  • Detail‑oriented, proactive, and unafraid to make tough calls when it comes to reliability and safety.

Bonus points

  • Experience with Heroku, Cloudflare, or Vercel environments.
  • Background in security compliance frameworks and audit preparation.
  • Familiarity with performance tuning for multi‑tenant SaaS systems.

Why join

You’ll own the backbone of Reflow’s reliability and trust, ensuring the systems that power our intelligence platform are secure, scalable, and efficient. You’ll work directly with founders and engineers, improving deployment speed, observability, and resilience. This role is perfect for someone who loves systems thinking and wants meaningful influence over infrastructure evolution.

Compensation

We offer competitive pay based on the market and where you’re located. The salary ranges in our job postings are intentionally wide because they need to cover both U.S. and international candidates. Our final offer will depend on things like your experience, skill set, and location.

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
description:
At PPRO, our mission is to simplify access to local payment methods and our vision is to enable the sale of goods and services to anyone in the world using their preferred way to pay. We empower partners such as Ant Group, PayPal and Stripe to access new markets, connect with more customers, and accelerate their growth.

Our strength lies in our diverse global team with 50+ nationalities and 10+ international locations – all united around one goal: to deliver the best possible products and services to our partners and customers.

The Purpose:

As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer in PPRO's Performance Powerhouse team, you will define the technical vision and architecture for ML‑driven payment optimization across the organization. You will move beyond executing well‑defined problems to identifying and framing the highest‑leverage opportunities—bridging strategy, architecture, and execution across multiple teams. You'll partner deeply with Product, Data, Core Payments, and Platform Engineering to set standards, eliminate systemic bottlenecks, and ensure PPRO's ML capabilities scale with the business.

This role is for engineers who have mastered ML and software craft at the senior level and are now ready to multiply their impact through technical leadership, mentorship of senior engineers, and architectural decisions that shape how the Data & ML organization builds and deploys ML systems. You will be the technical authority on ML for payments at PPRO—setting the direction others follow, raising the bar across the discipline, and driving alignment across engineering, product, and data teams.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Define ML Technical Strategy: Drive the multi‑quarter roadmap for ML‑driven authorization optimization, routing intelligence, and retry strategies. Identify the highest‑impact opportunities before they become obvious, and build the case for investment with data and business framing.
  • Architect Foundational ML Systems: Design and lead the implementation of shared ML infrastructure – feature stores, model serving platforms, experimentation frameworks that accelerate every team building on payments data, not just your own.
  • Drive Cross‑Team Technical Standards: Author and champion ML engineering standards across PPRO (model governance, monitoring, MLOps patterns), ensuring consistency, reliability, and reproducibility organization‑wide.
  • Solve Ambiguous, High‑Stakes Problems: Take on challenges where the problem itself isn't well‑defined. You scope, structure, and sequence the work – then lead execution across multiple engineers and teams to deliver.
  • Mentor and Level Up Senior Engineers: Actively invest in the growth of Senior engineers through design reviews, pairing on hard problems, sponsoring stretch opportunities, and raising expectations for what "production‑ready ML" means at PPRO.
  • Lead Experimentation at Scale: Design the experimentation strategy for live payment traffic—including multi‑armed bandits, causal inference approaches, and traffic‑splitting frameworks—ensuring sound statistical methodology across the team.
  • Elevate Engineering Culture: Run design reviews, set expectations for technical documentation, and create the internal forums (guilds, working groups, RFCs) that help ML practitioners across teams learn from each other and align on standards.

What We Are Looking For

  • ML Architecture at Scale: Demonstrated experience designing and shipping ML systems that serve multiple products or teams—not just models, but the platforms, contracts, and abstractions that make ML reusable and reliable at scale.
  • Technical Leadership Without Authority: Proven ability to drive technical decisions across teams you don't manage—through clear writing, credibility, and the ability to synthesize competing perspectives into a coherent path forward.
  • Deep Classical & Applied ML Mastery: Expert‑level command of classical ML (XGBoost, LightGBM, calibration, cost‑sensitive learning) with the judgment to know when—and when not—to reach for more complex approaches. You've operated beyond standard accuracy metrics and can design evaluation frameworks appropriate to the problem.
  • Production ML Engineering: Extensive experience taking models from experimentation to high‑throughput, low‑latency production environments. You've owned reliability, SLAs, and incident response for ML systems, and you've built MLOps tooling—not just consumed it.
  • Software Engineering Excellence: You write and review code at a senior+ level in Python, hold the team to high standards for testability and maintainability, and can credibly engage in systems design discussions with Principal and Staff engineers across Data and Platform.
  • Strategic Thinking & Business Acumen: You connect technical decisions to business outcomes—approval rate improvements to revenue, latency reductions to conversion, model drift to operational risk. You communicate clearly with non‑technical stakeholders and can translate ambiguous business goals into concrete ML problems.
  • Payments Domain Depth: Strong understanding of the card payment lifecycle, issuer behavior, authorization codes, retry logic, network rules, and 3DS. You use domain knowledge to inform feature design, model architecture, and experimentation strategy—not just as background context.
  • Cloud Infrastructure Mastery: Deep experience designing and owning ML infrastructure on AWS or GCP at scale, including infrastructure‑as‑code, cost management, and the ability to make build‑vs‑buy decisions on platform components.

What we offer:

  • Hybrid working – We offer a hybrid structure with a 3 days / week on site expectation, so you can strike the balance between office and home working. In addition to our 30‑day holiday allowance, we also provide a work from abroad policy, enabling employees to work remotely for up to another 30 days per year.
  • Learning and Development – We offer a 3,000 BRL annual budget to support your professional growth. In addition, we provide leadership cafés, on‑the‑job training, and other opportunities to help you grow your skills and thrive in your role.
  • Insurance – Because better safe than sorry, we want our employees to benefit from various insurances including life insurance, health insurance, dental plan and travel insurance.
  • Meal vouchers – BRL 54 / day – Enjoy a moment of conviviality and a good and balanced meal thanks to your meal vouchers. You will also have the choice between meal allowance, supermarket voucher or both (splitting the total value in two).
  • Enhance Family Leave – We understand the importance of family – that's why we offer enhanced family leave to support you during key life moments.
  • Transportation Voucher – We will cover your costs of commute.
  • Gym membership – PPRO helps contribute toward the costs of your gym membership, supporting your physical fitness journey while easing the burden on your wallet.
  • New Value (Deals & Coupon Platform) – Get attractive discounts to restaurants, stores and events.
  • Mental Health Platform – We’ve teamed up with a top well‑being platform to provide one‑on‑one therapy, chat therapy, therapist‑led courses, guided meditations, and more.
  • SESC – private institution that makes available Education, Health, Culture and Recreational programs and events and provides Social Assistance to our employees and their dependents.
  • Pet‑friendly office – Because work is better with your paw‑tners by your side.

description:

Rémunération : A définir

Fondée en 864, la Monnaie de Paris est à la fois la plus ancienne des institutions françaises et la plus ancienne entreprise du monde.
Etablissement public à caractère industriel et commercial (EPIC) depuis le 1er janvier 2007 et rattaché au Ministère de l’Economie et des Finances, notre mission depuis 12 siècles consiste à frapper la monnaie des français, et depuis le XIXème siècle, celles d’autres pays du monde (environ 40 aujourd’hui). La Monnaie de Paris est composée d'environ 500 collaborateurs.
Depuis 1973, notre activité est répartie sur deux sites :

  • Le site historique du Quai de Conti à Paris, où sont réalisées les productions d’art (monnaies de collection en métaux précieux, médailles, décorations officielles, fontes d’art et bijoux) mais également où est assurée la conservation, la protection et la présentation au public de nos collections historiques au travers du Musée de la Monnaie de Paris.
  • L’usine de Pessac en Gironde, où sont fabriquées les pièces d’euro pour la France, les monnaies des pays étrangers mais aussi les monnaies de collections et les jetons touristiques.
    Les activités commerciales exercées dans le secteur concurrentiel représentent dorénavant 70% de nos revenus.

Enfin, au sein de notre Institution, le sentiment d’appartenance est un vecteur important de notre dynamique. C’est pourquoi la Monnaie de Paris s’engage à promouvoir les talents internes afin de leur offrir les meilleures opportunités d’évolution et à rechercher de nouveaux talents externes pour répondre aux exigences d'aujourd’hui et aux défis de demain.

Mission générale

Vous êtes rattaché à la Responsable Communication digitale et produits au sein dela Direction du marketing et de la communication et êtes responsable de la mise en œuvre des projets de communication 360° visant à promouvoir la nouvelle offre de métal‑investissement, lancée par la Monnaie de Paris en juin 2026.

Détail du poste

Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec plusieurs directions de la Monnaie de Paris, telles que la direction commerciale, la direction de la stratégie et la direction des systèmes d’information.
Vos responsabilités vous conduisent à gérer des projets de communication impliquant divers interlocuteurs et experts internes (responsable commercial, économiste, juriste, responsable de projets SI…) et externes (agences, partenaires…).

Responsabilités

  • Piloter et suivre le déploiement du plan de communication 360° de la nouvelle gamme de produits :
    • vous assurez la pertinence et la cohérence du plan de communication, en lien avec votre hiérarchie ;
    • vous contribuez au bon déploiement du plan de communication post‑lancement de l’offre, en coordonnant les actions et en suivant leur performance.
  • Participer à l’élaboration d’un plan de communication fil rouge, ainsi que des plans de communication des années 2 et 3 (post‑lancement), en définissant les axes stratégiques, les outils et les dispositifs nécessaires pour répondre aux objectifs de notoriété, d’image et de développement commercial.
  • Coordonner les parties prenantes internes et externes : vous assurez la cohérence des messages entre les équipes internes et les partenaires externes (agences de communication, agences médias, etc.).
  • Assurer la gestion simultanée de plusieurs projets de communication produit, avec un focus principal sur le suivi de la nouvelle gamme : vous pilotez les projets de bout en bout, dans le respect des plannings et des budgets, et veillez à la qualité et à la cohérence des messages avec la stratégie de marque.

Missions principales :

  • Vous déployez et pilotez le plan de communication 360° : vous supervisez la mise en œuvre des projets offline, online et social media, suivez l’avancement des actions et garantissez le respect des délais.
  • Vous assurez le suivi de la performance des actions : vous définissez et analysez les indicateurs de performance (KPI), consolidez les résultats et formulez des recommandations d’optimisation.
  • Vous préparez et contribuez activement aux instances de pilotage internes (comités, copil…) ainsi qu’aux échanges avec les prestataires et agences.
  • Vous restituez les résultats : vous collaborez avec les équipes communication, marketing et commerciales pour préparer des bilans, présenter les résultats et partager les enseignements à l’ensemble de l’organisation.

Profil, Expérience, Formation

Diplômé(e) d’un Bac +4/5 en communication, vous justifiez d’une expérience professionnelle réussie d’au moins 5 ans sur un poste similaire.

Compétences / Savoir-faire :

  • Vous maîtrisez les principes de la communication stratégique et de la communication 360° (médias et hors médias), ainsi que les points de contact avec le client final (site web, brochures, emailing, vidéo, etc.).
  • Vous maîtrisez les outils de communication et possédez une bonne connaissance des médias traditionnels (presse, TV, radio) et digitaux (réseaux sociaux, blogs, sites web), ainsi que des outils graphiques et multimédia.
  • Vous savez suivre et évaluer l’impact des actions de communication.
  • Vous disposez de solides compétences en gestion de projet (maîtrise des plannings, des délais et des ressources).
  • Vous faites preuve d’une forte capacité à coordonner des équipes internes et externes (agences, prestataires, etc.).
  • Vous êtes capable de travailler sur plusieurs projets simultanément et de prioriser efficacement les tâches.
  • Vous possédez d’excellentes compétences rédactionnelles et savez adapter vos contenus à différents supports.
  • Vous êtes en capacité de suivre et d’analyser les résultats des actions de communication : compréhension et suivi des indicateurs clés (KPI), participation à la création de reportings et contribution aux bilans et recommandations.

Savoir-être :

  • Vous avez un fort esprit d’équipe et le sens du travail collaboratif.
  • Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils collaboratifs et de gestion de projet.
  • Vous faites preuve d’un excellent sens de l’organisation et d’une grande rigueur dans la gestion des priorités et des délais.
  • Vous êtes à l’aise à l’oral et savez communiquer efficacement en réunion ou en présentation.
  • Vous manifestez une forte appétence pour le secteur bancaire, financier et de l’investissement, avec une bonne compréhension de ses enjeux et de ses tendances.
  • Vous possédez une connaissance approfondie des spécificités du secteur financier et des produits bancaires et d’investissement, vous permettant de concevoir des messages percutants et adaptés aux attentes des clients et investisseurs.

Venir à la Monnaie de Paris, c’est rejoindre une institution engagée dans la diversité et l’inclusion, un bel environnement de travail, dynamique et stimulant…

Estamos em busca de um(a) Power BI Backend Developer apaixonado(a) por dados, arquitetura e performance, para atuar na sustentação e evolução das fundações que suportam todo o ecossistema de Business Intelligence da organização.

Arquitetura e Desenvolvimento Backend

DAX Avançado e Lógica de Negócio

  • Desenvolver medidas DAX complexas para cálculos avançados, análises temporais (Time Intelligence), regras de negócio dinâmicas e indicadores corporativos.

  • Diagnosticar e corrigir inconsistências relacionadas a contexto de avaliação, relacionamentos ambíguos e modelagens inadequadas.
  • Garantir escalabilidade e performance das regras de negócio implementadas.

Performance e Otimização

  • Realizar análises aprofundadas de performance em modelos e datasets.
  • Otimizar consultas, medidas DAX e estratégias de Calculation Groups.
  • Avaliar Query Folding e identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de transformação.
  • Reduzir tamanho dos modelos por meio da otimização de tabelas e estruturas de dados.
  • Utilizar ferramentas como Performance Analyzer para investigar gargalos e melhorar a experiência dos usuários.

Integração de Dados e ETL

  • Trabalhar em parceria com as equipes de Engenharia de Dados para definir estruturas de dados adequadas antes da ingestão no Power BI.

    • Arquivos estruturados
    • Conectores de terceiros
  • Validar pipelines de atualização, conexões, credenciais e estratégias de Incremental Refresh.
  • Garantir estabilidade e eficiência nos fluxos de ingestão e transformação de dados.

Governança, Segurança e Qualidade dos Dados

  • Administrar regras de segurança utilizando Row-Level Security (RLS).
  • Gerenciar permissões e acessos em workspaces e datasets.
  • Garantir a confiabilidade dos dados, sucesso das atualizações e conformidade com padrões de qualidade.
  • Monitorar uso dos ambientes, capacidade, armazenamento, custos de processamento e saúde geral dos datasets.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de governança de dados e padronização das soluções analíticas.

Suporte Técnico e Resolução de Problemas

  • Investigar e solucionar incidentes relacionados a:
    • Erros de DAX e regras de negócio
    • Falhas de atualização e problemas de gateway
    • Inconsistências de qualidade dos dados
    • Impactos nos relatórios gerados por lógicas de backend
  • Fornecer suporte técnico às equipes na interpretação de estruturas de dados, métricas e KPIs.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para temas relacionados à arquitetura e modelagem de dados no Power BI.

O que buscamos

Hard Skills

  • Forte experiência em modelagem dimensional, incluindo:

  • Conhecimento sobre governança, segurança e melhores práticas de arquitetura de BI.

Soft Skills

  • Perfil altamente analítico e estruturado para resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Capacidade de comunicar conceitos técnicos de forma clara para diferentes públicos.
  • Habilidade para atuar em colaboração com engenheiros de dados, arquitetos, analistas e stakeholders de negócio.

  • Mentalidade de melhoria contínua e busca constante por excelência técnica.

Diferenciais

Resumo da Posição

Esta posição é ideal para profissionais que desejam atuar profundamente nos pilares técnicos do Power BI, sendo responsáveis pela modelagem de dados, arquitetura, performance, governança e confiabilidade das soluções analíticas. title: Cloud Security Engineer
description:
Role Purpose

The Cloud Security Engineer demonstrates a high level of professionalism, leveraging in-depth knowledge in cloud security and a basic understanding of related cybersecurity disciplines to adapt departmental plans and recommend optimal solutions and best practices within the Cyber Security Engineering & Automation department. This individual contributor role manages cloud security projects and processes independently with limited supervision, allowing for tactical choices within established functional policies and broad procedures to achieve security goals. They are responsible for the execution of main cloud security activities to achieve important security outcomes, actively participating in small to medium-sized projects of moderate complexity and contributing to process improvements. The Engineer performs a variety of complex tasks, requiring detailed analysis to understand problems and supporting the delivery of solutions to intricate cloud security challenges where clear precedents may not exist.

Main Accountabilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain security controls across cloud platforms (IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS).
  • Define and enforce cloud security standards, guardrails, and reference architectures.
  • Secure cloud networking, identity, access management, and data protection services.
  • Implement and manage cloud security tooling such as CSPM, CWPP, CIEM, and WAF solutions.
  • Partner with cloud engineering and application teams to embed security into CI/CD and IaC pipelines (DevSecOps).
  • Conduct cloud security risk assessments, architecture reviews, and threat modeling.
  • Monitor cloud environments for misconfigurations, vulnerabilities, and security events, coordinating response with global SOC and IR teams.
  • Support regulatory, audit, and compliance requirements and global security standards.

description:
Ultahost is a fast-growing global web hosting and infrastructure company, delivering high-performance hosting solutions to businesses worldwide. Our success is driven by cutting-edge technology, reliability, and exceptional talent. We are expanding our HR team and looking for a Technical Talent Acquisition Specialist who will play a strategic role in building world-class technical teams.

Position Overview

As a Technical Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will lead and optimize the recruitment of senior and mid-level technical professionals across software engineering, DevOps, and infrastructure teams. You will act as a trusted partner to engineering leaders, driving hiring strategies, improving recruitment processes, and ensuring Ultahost continues to attract top-tier technical talent globally. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical recruitment expertise, market insight, and a consultative mindset.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage the full-cycle recruitment process for senior and high-impact technical roles, including Frontend, Backend, Full Stack, and DevOps positions.

    • Hosting & infrastructure: OpenLiteSpeed, NGINX, Apache, Docker, Linux, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
