title: Project Manager
description:
The Role


Kyndryl Project Managers oversee the delivery of major projects within scope, schedule, and budget. You’ll be the driving force for every aspect of a program’s success, and the “conductor” who orchestrates everyone’s efforts to make beautiful music together. As the single point of contact to the client, you’ll also be the living embodiment of Kyndryl’s reputation every day.


As Project Manager, you have command of a very full and detail-oriented calendar. You’ll be constructing detailed project plans, managing teams, and leading meetings, status calls, and planning and cadence meetings. You will analyze and mitigate risks, manage finances, make sure the team has the right skills, then plan and delegate activity to hit deadlines, deliver on SLAs, and generally delight our clients. Of course, plans often evolve as a project unfolds, so you’ll need to practice continuous structural thinking and take ownership for value delivery, not just task scheduling.


But as important as planning and organization are, communication is 90% of the job. You’re the single point of contact with the client, partners, and all stakeholders, supporting them and ensuring they get what they need. You’re also the bridge to every other team on the project, including both technical and account roles. The result is an exciting multicultural, often multilingual environment. Bottom line: You need to like interactions with other people and know how to be kind and empathetic but also assertive — and handle customer change requests with diplomacy.


You’re going to be meeting a lot of people, networking, and forging relationships. Our “one team with the customer” concept means you’ll develop especially strong partnerships with the client and elsewhere. Some projects or clients even involve “embedding” with the client at their location. This puts more visibility on you personally, but it also gives you more opportunity to add value to the relationship. This is one of the things Kyndryls love about working here. It’s a great way to hone your service and people skills, and it lays the groundwork for career growth both laterally and vertically.


Your future at Kyndryl


Becoming a Project Manager at Kyndryl is an excellent gateway to many different paths. You’ll be creating a well-rounded skillset while gaining professional certifications and qualifications. You can evolve horizontally into other technical or non-technical areas such as Technical Service Architect, or you can move vertically to become a senior project manager or program manager. There are many different types and flavors of PM roles, so everyone can find the opportunity that suits them best.


Who You Are


You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.


Required Skills and Experience



  • Experience with SCRUM methodology or Project Management practices

  • Basic knowledge of IT architecture and systems

  • Strong organizational and planning skills

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment with a \"One Team\" mindset

  • Bachelor's degree in IT, Networking, or Business Administration

  • MBA or postgraduate degree in project management

  • Availability for travel

  • Availability for in-person work in Rio de Janeiro, Salvador – BA, Recife – PE, Espirito Santo or Macaé - RJ


Preferred Technical and Professional Experience



  • Fluent in English (both written and spoken) or proficiency in another relevant language, as required

  • Experience using MS Project or other Project Management tools/software

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Proven ability to interact confidently with stakeholders at all levels


Being You


The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect


Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well‑being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.


From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.


We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in‑demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting‑edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands‑on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.


We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

title: DESENVOLVEDOR PRODUTOS PL
description:
JOB MISSION

The Product Engineer (Level II) at HwIT is a key technical contributor bridging R&D innovation and global manufacturing. This professional actively supports the industrialization cycle — from first R&D prototypes through NPI delivery to mass production — executing BOM control, product cost modeling, and equipment management for NPI, helping our customers' products achieve world-class manufacturing quality, competitive costs, and scalable production.

SCOPE & RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Product Lifecycle & Financial Control

  • BOM Management for Complex Products: Execute technical ownership of Bills of Materials, ensuring structural integrity, component traceability, and alignment with engineering changes.
  • Product Cost Control: Assist in developing and maintaining detailed product cost models, tracking cost drivers around materials and processes, and supporting cost reduction initiatives.
  • Engineering Change Control (ECR/ECN): Support the Engineering Change Request and Engineering Change Notice cycle, documenting modifications, capturing lessons learned, and evaluating industrial feasibility and cost impacts.

2. Process Design, NPI, and Global Transference

  • Process Flow, Requirements & Documentation: Assist in defining assembly process flows, line requirements, and maintaining comprehensive manufacturing documentation. Support process validations and failure analysis arising from process deviations.
  • NPI Equipment Management: Help define technical specifications for production equipment and materials, tracking procurement activities in collaboration with R&D and Manufacturing teams.
  • Manufacturing Capacity Model: Develop and update assembly line capacity models, collecting yields and process times to assist in ensuring production scalability and feeding capacity utilization data into cost models.
  • R&D to Manufacturing Bridge: Execute the technical transference of validated processes from R&D labs to high-volume manufacturing sites under senior technical guidance.
  • Global Product & Process Support: Travel to Asia, Europe, and the Americas to provide on-site support for manufacturing technology learning, process debugging, yield improvement, and failure analysis.
  • Equipment Transference Logistics: Assist in the logistics of equipment transfers between sites, tracking shipping, installation, and qualification.
  • R&D and Manufacturing Integration: Promote effective integration between R&D and Manufacturing teams, bridging technical language and ensuring engineering decisions are applied in production.

3. CANDIDATE PROFILE

Technical Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor's Degree in Production, Telecommunications, Electric, or Mechatronic Engineering.
  • Experience: Minimum of 3–5 years in Product/Process Engineering in high‑complexity industries.
  • Professional Certification: Knowledge of PMI or ASQ frameworks (e.g., CAPM, Green Belt) is a plus.
  • Global Mobility: Part of work time involves on-site visits to manufacturing and partner locations; remainder is local or remote.
  • Expertise: Solid knowledge in NPI, equipment/materials management, capacity planning, and production failure analysis.
  • Toolbox: Experience with PLM systems and JMP/Minitab. Technical knowledge in Python, C#, and/or LabVIEW is desirable.

Languages

  • Portuguese: Native.
  • English: Mandatory — Advanced/Fluent (B2/C1 level).
  • Spanish: Bilingual — Desirable.

Soft Skills (Aligned with HwIT Values)

  • Superar (Overcome): Resilience to resolve technical issues under pressure in remote factory environments.
  • Inovar (Innovate): Drive to find creative solutions to optimize assembly lines and identify root causes with the engineering team.
  • Desenvolver (Develop): Active participation in team knowledge sharing and continuous personal development in complex NPI environments.
